news_risk: No negative news, regulator action or enforcement item found in accessible public sources. Search backend (DuckDuckGo/searx) was unavailable during this check, so news coverage could not be exhaustively swept - absence of findings is not proof of absence. No OFAC SDN / UN / EU / UK / BIS Entity List match found; note that the OFAC Sanctions List Search tool is JavaScript-driven and returned no queryable results via plain HTTP, so the sanctions screen is a name-based negative inference from public sources, not a confirmed list query. Recommend a formal re-screen against the consolidated SDN/Non-SDN files before onboarding.
note: Risk-only scope. Company is active and operating: website live (setlite.com) with head office at 5-G Vandana Building, 11 Tolstoy Marg, Connaught Place, New Delhi 110001, plus service centres at Palwal and Ballabgarh (Haryana), warehouse at Kashmere Gate (Delhi), depot at Udaipur (Rajasthan) - source https://www.setlite.com/contact/. Self-described business: heavy equipment parts, engine/transmission overhauling, railway maintenance, '50+ countries served' - this is a marketing claim, not verified shipment evidence. Sanctions: no hit identified, but see caveat in news_risk about the OFAC tool not being machine-queryable. Court cases: four Indian records found on Indian Kanoon; two are the company as plaintiff (commercial recovery suits, 2014 and 2024), two are 2026 Delhi High Court matters where the company is a respondent alongside others - per project rules these are noted neutrally and are NOT rejection grounds. Credit rating: no public rating (CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings) found; recorded as null rather than inferred. RF/CIS supply: no evidence found - an Indian Kanoon search for 'Setlite Engineers' combined with 'Russia' returned zero matching results, and no customs, B-L or trade-data record linking the company to Russia or CIS was located. This is 'no traces found', not a confirmed negative. Fields I was instructed not to research (legal identity, CIN, HS codes, shipment volumes) were deliberately left untouched.
